description: BUNCH 1: Question Pipeline - Create API route, auto-loader hook, wire into Questions page, fix session-review.tsx to use loadAllQuestions()
steps: Create src/app/api/imported-questions/route.ts: GET handler that reads all *.json from content/metadata/imported-questions/, merges into flat array, filters out questions where NO answerChoice has isCorrect === true, returns JSON. If content/ folder does not exist return empty array.

Create src/features/question-bank/hooks/useImportedQuestions.ts: On mount check localStorage 'cfa-buddy-imported-questions'. If empty OR 'cfa-buddy-questions-loaded-at' timestamp is >24h old, fetch('/api/imported-questions'), store in localStorage, update timestamp. Export { questions, isLoading, refresh }. Use useState(() => ...) lazy initializer pattern, never useSyncExternalStore.

Convert src/app/(protected)/questions/page.tsx to use the hook: make it a client component wrapper that calls useImportedQuestions, shows 'Loading 1,000 questions...' state while fetching, then renders SessionConfigurator and QuestionAnalytics.

Fix src/features/question-bank/components/session-review.tsx: In loadReviewData function (line ~37), change 'sampleQuestions.filter(...)' to 'loadAllQuestions().filter(...)'. Also fix the currentQuestion lookup (line ~175) and the BatchFlashcardCreator prop (line ~480) to use loadAllQuestions() instead of sampleQuestions. Import loadAllQuestions from '../utils/question-loader'. Remove sampleQuestions import if no longer used.
Run npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint to verify no errors (ignoring prisma pre-existing).
Git commit with message: feat: serve imported questions via API + auto-load into browser
acceptance_criteria: API route at /api/imported-questions exists and returns JSON array (empty if no files exist)
Hook useImportedQuestions fetches from API and stores in localStorage with 24h cache
Questions page shows loading state while questions load
session-review.tsx uses loadAllQuestions() instead of sampleQuestions for all question lookups
